final_submission_validation.boundary: Separate real 0505 execution of the unchanged 25 fixed inputs; original 0450 rows remain historical observations; no new live-site, followup-UI, or Korean-conversation verification.

definitions.A1: 범용 색칠 확장 자체를 실행하지 않고, 같은 제공 상품 텍스트의 공식 명칭·공식 이명 단어 일치를 오프라인 계산한다; 사진 OCR·부족 상태·후속 행동은 없다.
definitions.A2: 동결 crawl_word_baseline.py의 run_product를 실제 실행하여 일치/일치 없음/근거 없음을 그대로 보존한다; 사진·모델·재독·질문은 없다.
definitions.B: A2의 상품 텍스트에 제공 사진 20장의 첫 원방향 OCR 원문을 각각 한 번 더해 공식 명칭·이명을 대조한다; 회전·대형사진 보정 추가·혼합물 내부 파싱·부족 판정·후속 행동은 없다.
definitions.C: 동일 25상품을 동결 integrated-0450 실제 API로 실행하여 목록 근거·읽은 범위·재시도/질문/보완 사유와 최종 결과를 기록한다.

first_ocr_warning_only_flag.reason: First OCR read warnings rather than the ingredient table; do not count this as the independently adjudicated target ingredient.

next_action_definition: unique positive products with native inquiry_draft evidence/reason events; overlaps with flagged products; not actual messages sent
limitations: No baseline no-match or no-evidence is relabeled as safety approval or false clearance.
No third-party highlighting extension was installed/executed for these 25 products.
A1 uses declared product text rather than scanning HTML metadata/navigation; not an exact browser-visible highlight count.
Saved-page local replay URLs were mapped to their recorded original iHerb URL only to select the existing adapter; supplied text was unchanged and no live fetch occurred.
A2 returns unsupported_site for all 20 NIH-domain inputs: 19 contain no page text and Echinacea has supplied text; this limitation is recorded, not called OCR failure.

B reuses first nonrotating OCR responses for exactly matching supplied image hashes, including observations acquired after questions in the historical run; no later OCR response or new reply material is added.
The common plan already prepares RGB JPEG quality90/max3200 images; B applies no additional preparation or rotation.
Raw word hits can include headings or warning text and are not ingredient identity adjudication.
0450 results are not relabeled as the newly frozen 0505; final 0505 rerun is scheduled after this comparison.
This combines OCR, code matching, model judgements and scope handling; it does not establish autonomous-policy superiority or advantage over a strong fixed workflow.
